packet_id_derivation: sha256 of a salt, the candidate id and the variant, truncated to 16 hex; the key mapping ids back to candidates lives outside the packets
removed_before_a_judge_sees_it: directories and files whose name contains commitlore, cdeb, arm, assignment or delivery
deliberately_not_removed: agent-written source and comments. Redacting those would mean the judge reads something other than what was produced, and a comment carrying a product word is the code rather than an arm cue.
record_id_finding: Record-Id appears in two gitseed files -- AGENTS.md and docs/adr/ADR-0008 -- in all 25 gitseed packets. They document the trailer format and carry placeholder and unrelated ids (r-<6+, r-gsf501, r-enadr17), none of which is a benchmark candidate's record. It is the base repository, identical across every gitseed packet, and removing it would alter the tree the judge is asked to read.
residual_risk: this scan finds textual cues. It cannot detect a stylistic cue -- if v6 and v7 builders write recognisably differently, a judge could learn that instead of the decision, and the surface-only control in corpus.json bounds how far size alone gets rather than proving no such cue exists.
